diagnosis: All rollouts passed content check C3 (decide on a license policy) without accessing PF2, the fact owned by A3 that flips C4 and C6. This suggests that the model is defaulting to the 'oss' license policy, which is part of the flip for C6. Since the model can satisfy C3 without needing PF2, this check is structurally leaky.
